text: Haltaf was a dual-wielding Draugr that was encountered during the Nede era.
Haldinil is an Altmer residing in the garden of Kinlady Avinisse's Mansion in the city of Shimmerene during the quest "The Queen's Decree." He has no unique dialogue.
Haibzur is a Khajiit who can be found in the Illumination Academy in Summerset. He is being chased by a cat with big ears.
Halimorion is a deceased Altmer whose body can be found in Russafeld, Summerset.
Haniana is an Altmer who can be found in a vanguard camp near Sea Keep in Summerset. She cannot be interacted with.
Hanu is a skilled Dunmer hunter seeking to enter Hircine's Hunting Grounds.
Halora is a character found in Enrick's Public House in Anvil, Gold Coast.
Halfas Varn is a priest during the Imperial Simulacrum, who resides in the Brotherhood of Seth in Camlorn, High Rock. Halfas plays a major role in the main quest of .
Hamvir is a Nord barbarian slaver who resides in the slave cave of Zebabi.
Haila is a Breton patrolling the outer towers of Northern High Rock Gate, Cyrodiil in .
Haj-Ru is an Argonian artisan residing at Lilmoth. He has no unique dialogue.
Haj-Ta is an Argonian residing at the Lilmoth Outlaws Refuge in Lilmoth.
Hadolids are a multi-limbed bipedal crab-like creature in . They are seafaring creatures, found on High Isle with other creatures such as the Vulk'esh.
Hand Kenro Hlan is a Dunmer in that is a part of the Ghosts of the Tribunal Creation Club content.
Havilstein Hoar-Blood is a Nord assassin and Silencer of the Black Hand who leads the Cyrodiilic Dark Brotherhood in .
Haskill is the chamberlain, councillor and savant of Sheogorath. His voice is quite calm and he shows no obvious signs of madness.
Harrow is a member of the Mythic Dawn who oversees new member inductions. He is also the Warden to the Shrine of Dagon, located within the Lake Arrius Caverns.
Harald was the first historic Nordic High King. He was the first ruler to establish a unified kingdom in Skyrim as it is known now. Harald was the thirteenth of Ysgramor’s lineage.

The Headless Zombie is one of the creatures encountered in . Headless Zombies are identical to normal zombies apart from their lack of a head. They are rotting, animated corpses, which can be summoned by using the Summon Headless Zombie spell. Their strength is scaled to the Hero's level, and they have a weakness to fire.

Hasphat Antabolis is an Imperial Drillmaster with the Fighters Guild in Balmora. He thinks of himself as a scholar and as such is particularly interested in Dwemer Ruins and artifacts. Hence he is also the author of Dwemer History and Culture which appears in both and . Having lived in Morrowind all his life and having talked a lot to backcountry mercenaries, he knows a lot about the country and its natives. Also because of that, Antabolis is quite knowledgeable on the subject of the Nerevarine Cult, and is the author of the book, Life and Times of the Nerevarine.
Hauls-Ropes-Faster is an Argonian sailor who can usually be found at The Fo'c's'le in Anvil.

Hanz gro-Hubrag is an Orsimer farmer living in the three house big settlement of Blankenmarch that lies along the Yellow Road. He carries a claymore with him and is very well dressed for being a farmer. His house is never locked but is a big mess with furniture tossed around the rooms. Outside of his house lies a small farm plot including Arrowroot, Blackberry, Carrot, Corn, Onion, Potato, Radish, Tobacco, Tomatoes and Wheat Grain.

Hassiri is a Khajiit scout residing in the Talos Plaza District of the Imperial City. He is also the co-owner of the Black Horse Courier, where he works together with his two brothers, Ra'jiradh and Urjabhi.
Harrald is a Nord in who is the son of Jarl Laila Law-Giver, found either in the training area outside of Mistveil Keep, or in the throne room.

Hasathil is a Bosmer residing in Anvil. She is the wife of sailor Heinrich Oaken-Hull, who spends most of his time out at sea. Despite her husband being gone most of the time, she says she is happy in Anvil and that the people are friendly. While she says that the Nine Divines give her some comfort, she can also be seen secretly meeting with Enilroth.

Hassour Zainsubani is a Dunmer Thief and an operative for the Thieves Guild who can be found downstairs, or in the backroom behind the bar, at the Ald Skar Inn in Ald'ruhn. He once belonged to an Ashlander tribe but left the Wastes to become a wealthy trader. People describe him as a bibliophile who loves poetry.
Hasell is a member of the Fighters Guild and resides in the Sadrith Mora Fighters Guild in Wolverine Hall.
Hean was a Redguard that lived in Morrowind during the Third Era. He was the head of the Imperial Cult in Ald'ruhn, although does not appear in .

Haromir of Copper and Tea was an Ayleid King of the city of Sancre Tor in Cyrodiil, which at the time was under the control of the Ayleids. In 1E 242, Haromir was challenged to a duel by Pelinal Whitestrake, a champion of the Alessian Slave Rebellion. He was defeated and killed by Whitestrake at Sancre Tor.

Haynekhtnamet was a Wamasu living in Black Marsh. Haynekhtnamet was slain by a group of northern men, and took seven days and nights to fall. One of the surviving men took one of his fangs, and carved it into a blade, and fashioned into a dagger. This dagger is called the Fang of Haynekhtnamet, and uses some of Haynektnamet's magical properties, including the ability to do shock damage on an opponent.
Harassa is a Khajiit slave residing in Yakanalit in Azura's Coast.
Harcourt Rernis is a Breton noble who resides in Daggerfall. He is rather upset that Lady Javierre has taken the last sweetroll.
Hasilium Epinard is a Redguard weaponsmith who resides in the city of Daggerfall. He can be found in the market, selling weapons at his stall, Zhosh's Bladeworks.
Hasmani is a Redguard residing in Port Hunding on the island of Stros M'Kai. He can be found fishing in the docks.
Harbormaster Reine is a Breton residing in the city of Daggerfall, Glenumbra. She serves as the harbormaster of the western Daggerfall Docks.
Hariba is a Khajiit patron of the Five Claws Inn in Woodhearth.
Haraenion is a Bosmer residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.

Hazazi is Khajiit member of the Aldmeri Dominion. He was sent to Bramblebreach in order to persuade the Bosmer clan residing there to integrate into the Dominion. Hazazi is later seen again, where he is part of the team that was sent to seal a daedric tear that opened up in Moonhenge.

Hazak is a Khajiit and the leader of the Crosstree Bandits, a group of skooma smugglers who operate out of Hazak's Hollow. Prior to his life of banditry, he was the father of Khari and the mate of Zulana.
Has-Many-Legs is a Dwarven Spider who is the pet of Neetra, a Mage from Skywatch. Has-Many-Legs can be found outside the Mages Guild tower, and when first met, it is broken and in need of repair.

Harrani is a Khajiit and the headwoman of Khenarthi's Roost off the south coast of Elsweyr. She handles the affairs of her people in political matters. Harrani is found inside the chancery in Mistral, the port city, where she conducts her duties.
Harvyn Darano is a Dunmer miner working at the Deepcrag Den.
Hashuri-daro is a Khajiit backpack merchant of the Baandari Clan. She sells her wares at her stall, Hashuri's Pouches & Pockets, at their caravan settled in Kozanset.
Hareld Falvo is an Imperial member of the Fighters Guild. He is the hall steward of their branch and responsible for recruiting new members in Sentinel.
Harim the Fastidious is a Redguard residing in the city of Evermore.
Harcourt Beriel is a character residing in the city of Camlorn.
Hasib is a Redguard merchant residing in the city of Silvenar. He owns and runs Silvenar Supplies.
Healer Dalen is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. He is found in their camp at Eidolon's Hollow, tending to the wounded soldiers there.
Harukar is a Redguard residing in the city of Bergama in the Alik'r Desert.
Hawnazh af-Jahannif is a Redguard member of The Crowns who can be found inside A'tor's Oasis in the city of Bergama, Alik'r Desert.
Hanubrina-ko is a character residing in the city of Kozanset.
Hareeya is an Argonian member of the Fighters Guild residing in the city of Sentinel.
Hayed is a Redguard commoner residing in the city of Sentinel.
Hanubina-ko is a Khajiit fortune teller of the Baandari Clan. She is part of their caravan settled in Kozanset.
Hara-Na is an Argonian captive of the Worm Cult found at the Lost Prospect.
Haras is a Bosmer member of the legendary Hounds of Hircine and a renowned hunter in Valenwood. He is currently tracking a rare Senche-Tiger known as The Pale Senche.
Harbin is a Breton found on the southern docks of Daggerfall.
Harfiza is a Redguard member of the Mages Guild found in the hall of Riften.
Harimal is a Redguard hunter found west of Cumberland's Watch. He is also the brother of Rama.
Harin is a Bosmer warrior participating in The Swordmaster Division at the Thizzrini Arena.
Hark Sentulus is an Imperial member of the Supernal Dreamers. He led the attack on Nurin Farm.
Harmolith is a Bosmer fisher found in Mathiisen. She had temporarily worked with the College of Aldmeri Propriety in some capacity.
Harnald is a Nord found inside the Frostheart House in Riften. With the help of his sister Amitra, he is investigating the presence of the Worm Cult in the Ragged Hills.
Harnskar is a Nord working at the dockyards in Davon's Watch.
Haron is a Bosmer hunter in who is found investigating the presence of Houndsmen sighted near Deepwoods.
Harza gra-Urish is an Orsimer residing in the town of Fell's Run, Rivenspire.
Has-Sugar-In-Him is an Argonian merchant selling his wares at his stall, Sugar's Corner Shop, in Dune.
Hasiwen is a Bosmer guild trader selling her wares at The Marbruk Mart in Marbruk.
Haytham is a Redguard warrior found north of Headman Bhosek's palace.
Hayya is the Khajiit innkeeper and proprietor of The Shining Star in the Hollow City.
Hazari is a Khajiit siege merchant and a member of Aldmeri Dominion. She is found on the road north of Vlastarus.

Hazaznaz is a Khajiit merchant in who is a part of the gang found inside the outlaws refuge underneath Vulkhel Guard. He claims to have once been an actor, and this is corroborated by The Canonreeve's Conundrum, which can be found behind his counter.
Hazzenie is a Redguard residing in the city of Belkarth, Craglorn.

Hazzi is a Redguard found in Hallin's Stand, Bangkorai, in . She is a daughter of Captain Dhakir at-Nimr and Qismah at-Nimr. At the beginning of the Imperial invasion of Hallin's Stand she was taken hostage and is guarded by Quatrius Scipio.
Head Shepherd Neloren is a Dunmer Cauterizer working with the Pit Rats, and mini-boss encountered in Darkshade Caverns I.
Head-in-Clouds is an Argonian mystic and member of the Mages Guild residing in Nimalten. She can be found in the local guildhall where she sells her wares.
Healer Nevam is a Dunmer priest found at the Shrine of Saint Veloth.

The Harmonic Auditor is an elderly Elf found within the Tonal Auditorium of Rkindaleft. He has been experimenting on the Orsimer who have entered Rkindaleft, infusing their souls with Dwemer technology in an effort to attain perfection, despite destroying their bodies and minds. They follow his orders, and he considers them his children, referring to them as beasts before he transformed them. He is attempting to infuse his soul into the Vessel of the Auditor, a Dwarven Centurion under his command, in an attempt to shed his mortal body.
Hareglor is a Bosmer found with his companion Maenrin at their campsite in Grahtwood.
Headsman is an unused Nord in . He was supposed to make an appearance in the unimplemented quest "WEDL11," but did not make it into the final version of the game.
Haven Archer is a generic archer residing in Blackheart Haven.
Haven Slip-Knife is a character residing in Blackheart Haven.
Haythehdi is a Redguard beggar residing in the Warehouse District in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Hasudel is an Altmer mystic of the Mages Guild residing in the guildhall in the Saint Delyn Waistworks of Vivec City.
Haxara is an Argonian egg-miner of the Bright-Throat Tribe who can be found in the Bright-Throat Village.
Headmaestro Catrelle Georick is a Breton residing in the Bards College in Solitude.

Havocrel Duke of Storms is a Havocrel boss that appears in . He is found at the end of Atoll of Immolation. Several waves of enemies must be defeated before he can be fought. He shields himself at various health intervals. Defeating him allows one to destroy the machine and causes a reward chest to appear.
Haxal is an Argonian brewer who works at The Lusty Argonian Footman of Lilmoth, Murkmire.

Head Reseracher Tedas is a Dunmer researcher of the Mages Guild found in the Daedric Ruins of Ramimilk, Vvardenfell, in . She can be found standing at the staircase overlooking the hall. She has no unique dialogue and cannot be interacted with.
The Havocrel Duke of Fire is a Havocrel boss that appears in . He is found in Waking Flame Fargrave Conclave.
The Havocrel are a race of Daedra that appear in . They are distinguished by having crimson skin, being very tall and blind.

Heem-La is an Argonian Mage in the Mages Guild in Ald'ruhn. He offers a number of Spells for purchase, including Alteration, Conjuration, Destruction, and two Illusion spells. He is not involved in any of the Mages Guild quests; he can be found there if his assistance in buying spells is needed.
Heifnir is a Nord trader living in Dagon Fel, Morrowind. He can be found inside his shop in the southern part of town, guarded by Thalestris.
Helga is a Nord commoner. She lives in a shack on the docks in the village of Khuul, where she has a copy of 2920, vol 12 - Evening Star sitting on a table.
Helviane Desele is a Breton Trader residing in Suran. She is the proprietor of Desele's House of Earthly Delights.

Hentus Yansurnummu is a Dunmer Miner living in Gnisis in the West Gash region. He can be found in the river outside Gnisis, stuck there because his pants had been stolen by Hainab Lasamsi while he was having a bubble bath. The Nerevarine has the option of retrieving his pants and, once he gets them back, he starts wandering about town.

Henantier is an Altmer who lives with Kud-Ei, his friend, in his house in Bravil. Both him and Kud-Ei are mages at the Bravil Mages Guild. In the quest "Through a Nightmare, Darkly," he is under enchantment by an amulet that is keeping him in a deep sleep where he is bound by his own nightmares. Kud-Ei calls upon the hero to save him.
Heidmir is a Nord living in Ebonheart. He is also a member of the Imperial Legion.
Helgi was a Nord child and the daughter of Hroggar, who lived in Morthal. She and her mother burned to death in a house fire set by Laelette, investigated in the quest "Laid to Rest."
Hefid the Deaf is a mentally-unstable and deranged beggar who can be found hidden away in the Ratway Warrens, under Riften.
Helgird is an Elder Nord priestess of Arkay who can be found in the Hall of the Dead in Windhelm.
Hecerinde is an Altmer agent who resides on the east bank of the Odai River in Balmora. He is a highly skilled member of the Thieves Guild.
Hemming Black-Briar is a Nord and the eldest son and heir of Maven Black-Briar and father to Sibbi and Ingun. He lives in Riften, in the Black-Briar Manor.
Heimvar is a Nord blacksmith. He lives and works in the Solitude Blacksmith building as the apprentice of Beirand.

Hellena was the Queen of Lilmoth, wife of Emperor Magnus Septim, and mother of Emperor Pelagius Septim III. Sometime before 3E 109, she became ruler of the kingdom of Lilmoth following the execution of the Argonian priest-king and represented Imperial interests in Black Marsh. In Waughin Jarth's series The Wolf Queen, she is described as a "diplomat by nature" and able to "recognize and confront adversity" as the Cyrodilic ruler of an Argonian kingdom. The Daedric Prince Sheogorath described Hellena as "unique," but "fairly average for a Septim," and claimed that she either "wielded fear like a cleaver" or that she would "wield a cleaver and make people afraid." Sheogorath attributes her son
Helvo Atius is an Imperial who lives in the Talos Plaza District in the Imperial City.
Henantier the Outsider was the first Elven Harbinger of the Companions.
Heimdall the Frenzied was a Nord warrior sometime in late Merethic Era or early First Era. Heimdall fought during the final battle against the Snow Elves.
Hemus Zelma-Alit is a Dunmer archer who resides at the Salit Camp in the Grazelands of Morrowind.
Heddic Volunnar was a Nord warrior whose corpse may be found in Volunruud.

Helgreir Lute-Voice was a bard in Windhelm sometime during the Second Era. They are the author of the book Jorunn the Skald-King. According to the loading screen of Taleon's Crag, Helgrier and Taleon Mythmaker once had a literary dispute. As of 2E 580, he was the Bard Royal of Windhelm, representing Jorunn the Skald-King.
Helena is a prisoner in , and is found in the Broken Wing. She is in search of the person who murdered her family, and asks the Soul of Conflict to help her uncover the assassin's identity.

Hlaalu Helseth was a Dunmer King of Morrowind during the later fourth century of the Third Era, the son of Queen Barenziah and General Symmachus. He was notorious for his cunning character and scheming ways.

Helath Stormbinder is a character in . During the Third Era, the Eternal Champion was an owner of the Ebony Mail. It was hidden in Black Marsh after the previous owner, Helath Stormbinder, lost the favor of Boethiah. Following a strange map, the Eternal Champion eventually found the resting place of the mail and retrieved it for his war against Jagar Tharn.
Heniele Milielle is a Breton maid working at the Indarys Manor.
Heedul is an Argonian slave who resides in the cave of Kudanat.
Helfar Ice-Mane is a Nord mentioned in the . He is a trader, and the author of From the notebook of Helfar Ice-Mane, trader.

Heragaeth is a Bosmer ghost found in the Temple of Mourning Springs after the quest "Tears of the Two Moons" has been completed, and once the ghosts have returned to the temple. She is the lover of Ilring.

Hendil is an Altmer citizen who can be found in Phaer on the island of Auridon. He can be found in Aninwe's barn trying to ease other Altmer afflicted with the same sickness as his son on mainland Auridon.
Heir-Zish is an Argonian Slave who resides in the slave cave of Hinnabi.
Hendaril is a traveling Altmer merchant, who can be found wandering the roads nearby the Firsthold Wayshrine, and selling his goods to travelers and adventurers.

Heart-Wife Sholg is an Orsimer on the island Betnikh and is one of Chief Tazgol's wives. Another wife is Forge-Wife Glesh. Sholg wants her daughter Lokra to do her duty and stop thinking about being an adventurer.
Henandan is a Bosmer smith residing in Woodhearth in the region of Greenshade.
Henendor is an Altmer magus residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood. He can be found in the local Mages Guild.
Hegaer is a Bosmer residing in Redfur Trading Post in the region of Grahtwood.

Hel Ra'Lala is a Redguard residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven. She is first met at the Cloudy Dregs Inn, not far from the north gate in the city. The Vestige will get their map updated with a mark, where they can go and find a treasure, when they talk to her. Later on, they may find Hel Ra'Lala at the nearby Undaunted enclave. Hel Ra'Lala is, in fact, called Hel al-Ragath, and is the mother of Maj al-Ragath.
Helese Gelves is a Breton residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven. She is a weaponsmith and offers her services in the Red Squall Armory along with the woodworker Shurkul.
Helindil is an Altmer residing in the city of Dawnbreak, in Auridon. He works as the chief servant at Dawnbreak Manor.
Hednor is a Bosmer member of the Brackenleaf's Briars residing in the town of Brackenleaf.
Herald Fisalie is a character residing in the city of Marbruk.
Henodras is a Bosmer residing in the Shrouded Vale, in the region of Greenshade.
Helgana Hroason is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact found resting inside the Grandmaster's Palace in Kragenmoor.
Hengeki is a Nord who resides at the Shad Astula academy. She is usually reading a book nearby a cropping of rocks on the bank of one of the ponds on the grounds.
Helazh is a Redguard member of the Mages Guild residing on the island of Eyevea.
Henona Lylvieve is a Breton residing in the city of Wayrest.
Heathre is a Khajiit member of the Undaunted. She is found playing music at their enclave in Mournhold.
Hennus is a Dunmer farmer found at the edge of the Sulfur Pools. He is looking for his guar herd, which was scattered when the Daggerfall Covenant attacked.
Helazh at-Renazh is a Redguard noble residing in Vivec City in the Vvardenfell region of Morrowind. She can be found praying to the Shrine of Generosity at the Temple Canton.
Heleni is a Khajiit commoner residing in the town of S'ren-ja.

Herald Kixathi is a Dremora and the leader of the Primeval Seekers, a cult working on the behalf of Hermaeus Mora. She is investigating the presence of a powerful Nereid found deep in the ruins of Bisnensel.

Henrik War-Wolf is a Nord leatherworker selling his wares at the Stormcrag Armorer's Hall in Windhelm. Once the Hollow City is restored, he moves there and open a stall, Flexible Protection, at the marketplace where he sell his new wares.
Heimunda Stormfist is a Nord found in Windhelm. She is one of the runners taking part in The Konunleikar, a race taking place in the city.
Hearth-Wife Sholg is an Orsimer and one of the wives of Chief Tazgol, the leader of the Seamount Clan, in .
Heculoa is a Maormer member of the Sea Vipers found with his Giant Snake Weyand in the South Beacon.
Hedranna Kaliki is Dunmer Ashlander and the leader of the Kagesh Tribe. She can be found in her camp near Iliath Temple, trying to defuse the situation between the tribe and the priests.

Hedyn is a wounded Chimer encountered in the vision of Mavos Siloreth. He was present during the binding of Balreth in the First Era, and lost his life then. He is found lying in the Charred Ridge, accessible only during the "Rending Flames" quest.
Hegris the Black Dagger is a Nord bandit and the current leader of Black Daggers, a group of brigands plaguing the Chorrol countryside.
Heiress Alona is a Reachman member of the Stonetalon Clan found in the Northwind Mine.
Hekvid is a Dunmer residing in the city of Nimalten, The Rift.
Helgi Pine-Frost is a Nord member of the Mages Guild. She is the magister of their guildhall in Riften.
Helgith is a Nord and one of the survivors of the Worm Cult's attack on Treva's Farm.
Helmir the Headscratcher is a Bosmer prisoner found in Hadran's Caravan.
Helonel is an Altmer member of the Veiled Heritance found dead north of the Shattered Grove.
Helpirion is an Altmer bard performing at The Ebony Flask in Ebonheart.

Helvia Livianus is an Imperial member of the Worm Cult. She has infiltrated the Crimson Raiders, a group of pirates holed up in the Crimson Cove. She can be seen dealing with Captain Siro, an officer of the Seventh Legion that infiltrated the pirates as well.
Helwyn is a Breton member of Captain Currod's crew found on The Tava's Bounty, currently docked in Koeglin Village. She can be found leaning against the mizzenmast, and has no unique dialogue.
Hemgar is a Nord soldier of the Pact found at the Southern Morrowind Gate.
Hengekeeper Lara is a Bosmer and the safekeeper of Treehenge, the resting place of The Green Ladies.
Henrinora is a Bosmer member of the Fighters Guild buying supplies in Longhaven.
Heralbor is a Bosmer chef residing in the city of Karthdar, Grahtwood, first met in the Sacred Cave of the town. He sells his wares at Karthdar Meats and Treats, his stall there.
Henarsare is an Orsimer priestess of Trinimac found in the Temple of Ire in the city of Orsinium. She is impossible to interact with.
Hearth-Wife Barazal is an Orsimer found in Scarp Keep in the city of Orsinium. She is one of King Kurog's wives, but cannot be interacted with while in the Keep.
Henenme is a character residing in the Hubalajad Palace in the city of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Helainie Simiseph is a Breton found inside the castle of Anvil. She cannot be interacted with.
Hears-the-Stone is an Argonian Tel Var Lockbox Merchant and member of the Ebonheart Pact. She is found at their base within Harena Hypogeum.
Heed-Jush is an Argonian member of the Ebonheart Pact stationed at Fort Virak.
Heed-Nakal is an Argonian laborer and patron of the Hew's Mane inn in Abah's Landing.
Hegor is a Bosmer found at the entrance of the Shrouded Vale.

Henrik is an unused Nord in . He was supposed to make an appearance in the quest "The Wolf Queen Awakened," but was never added to the final version of the game. He wears a belted tunic and a pair of boots.
Henri Marceau is a Breton member of the Daggerfall Covenant. He is the last surviving member of the Covenant team that went into the Bonestrewn Crest.
Henriette Panoit is a Breton guild trader. She sells her wares at the Seasisde Exchange in Morkul Stronghold.
Hel Hodgrym is a female Nord farmer in who resides in Bleakrock Village on Bleakrock Isle.
Helunda is a Nord member of the Ebonheart Pact stationed at Fort Virak.
Hensora is a Khajiit found in the Warehouse District of Abah's Landing.
Helene the Deaf is a buried female character in New Sheoth Graveyard. She is one of 8 other inhabitants of the Shivering Isles already buried at the arrival of the Hero of Kvatch on the isles.
Hedstagg is a Nord smith residing in Foundation's Labor in Vivec City. He offers no unique dialogue.
Helseth Sadalvel is a Dunmer caravaner working at the top of the Caravaner Tower at Pilgrim's Approach in Vivec City, Vvardenfell, in . She provides transport to Suran, Balmora, Gnisis, and Tel Mora.

Hecua, is a character who appears in An Elder Scrolls Novel: The Infernal City. She is a Redguard who ran an alchemy store in Lilmoth, Black Marsh. Hecua's alchemy store was huge. It used to be the Mages' Guild hall of Lilmoth, until it was disbanded after the Great War. Some former practitioners still lived in the building, and Hecua honored their membership.
Hears-the-Winding is an Argonian member of the Clockwork Apostles found at The Cloisters inn in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.
Hengolar is a Bosmer residing in the Plaza of the Eight outside Shimmerene. He says that his brother has been taken by the guard to the Monastery of Serene Harmony in the city for questioning.
Henunewe is an Altmer commoner found near the Abacean Imports stall in the Plaza of the Eight in Shimmerene, Summerset. She has no unique dialogue.
Henrik Seven-Swords is a member of the Blades and the former mentor of the Fugitive. He is first encountered during the quest "Meet the Old Blademaster."
Heed-Meeus is an Argonian member of the Bright-Throat Tribe residing in Bright-Throat Village, Murkmire.
Heralda Faleille is a Breton that has taken shelter, like most of the other residents, within the Elinhir sewers away from the renegade Blackcaster Mages Guild.
Hedrynne is a Nord encountered just outside of Chillwind Depths.

Herma-Mora, also known as The Woodland Man, is the Skaal, Nordic and Bosmeri interpretation of the Daedric Prince Hermaeus Mora. He is generally regarded as a demon, who once nearly tricked the Nords into becoming Altmer. Ysgramor has many myths related to escaping the wiles of this demon. Bosmeri cultists claim that Herma-Mora is a separate entity from Hermaeus Mora, but most scholars doubt this. After seducing him with promises of power, Miraak secretly plotted against his dragon master. Herma-Mora helped the Dragon Priest escape Vahlok the Jailor when the latter was about to deliver the killing blow. Miraak would become his servant thereafter. The Skaal know him as the Demon of Knowledge.

Herminia Cinna is an Imperial in residing in her house in the Imperial City's Elven Gardens District. She is a scholar specializing in the late Ayleid period, and has authored a book about the Ayleid period titled The Last King of the Ayleids. Herminia also collects Ayleid artifacts. When she is not home, Herminia can frequently be found wandering about the Imperial City or visiting the Cheydinhal Bridge Inn in Cheydinhal.
Hinald is a Redguard Pawnbroker who lives in Druegh-jigger's Rest in Gnaar Mok, Morrowind. He is a member of the Thieves Guild and sells various goods.

High-Heart is an Argonian slave who can be found in Molag Mar, Morrowind. He can be found across the city's plaza from the Temple. High-Heart will refuse to escape even if he is freed from his bracer.
Hides His Eyes is an Argonian Scout, and an escaped slave who resides in Suran. He poses as his own bounty hunter. His name is a translation from his original Argonian name, Haj-Ei.
Hil the Tall is a Nord priest and Illusion trainer in Cheydinhal.
Hides-His-Heart is an Argonian enforcer who was hired to kill Francois Motierre for not paying some criminal underworld types a debt for the gold he borrowed from them.
Hillod the Outlaw is a Redguard member of the Thieves Guild who lives in the Imperial City Waterfront.
Herdir is an Imperial warrior residing in the Shivering Isles. He works as the torturer for Lady Syl of Dementia. He spends nearly all of his time in the torturer chambers behind Syl's courtroom.
Herd is a Nord Barbarian residing in the cave of Sinsibadon.
Hilde is an elderly Nord who lives in Riverwood. She is the mother of Sven, Riverwood's local bard.
Hewnon Black-Skeever is a Nord and a small-time bandit who, along with his accomplice Drahff, is encountered shortly after entering The Ratways beneath Riften.
Hern is a Nord vampire living at the Half-Moon Mill with Hert, his vampire wife.
Hermir Strong-Heart is a Nord and a blacksmith-in-training belonging to the Strong-Heart house located in Windhelm.
Hillevi Cruel-Sea is a Nord merchant who sells food in Windhelm's marketplace.
Heratar is a Nord bandit and servant of the Daedric Prince Hircine. He is found inside Bloated Man's Grotto during the quest "Ill Met by Moonlight." He wears a full set of steel armor.
Hermeskr was an Atmoran warrior who lived during the Merethic Era. He was one of the Five Hundred Companions.
Hickim is a Redguard Assassin and a member of the Morag Tong who resides in Balmora in the Lucky Lockup.

Herbane was an adventurer and author who traveled across Skyrim, searching for the most dangerous of creatures and exploring the province. In his writings he mentions his continued search of a challenge worthy of story and ends each book with a boastful statement that he was yet to encounter anything that would make him tremble. He was going to be featured in , but was cut from the game. He has found, fought, and won over Hagravens, Ice Wraiths, and Animunculi. He has delved deep into Dwemer Ruins, survived frozen, freezing tundras of Skyrim and the wonders and dangers of the Reach.
Hingor is a Bosmer Scout member of the Imperial Legion holding the rank of Trooper.

Hestra was the Empress of the Alessian Empire during the early First Era. She is known to have believed that when the Dragon Break of the Middle Dawn occured, Cyrodiil "became an Empire across the stars."
Hetman Guls is a Dunmer master-at-arms, and member of House Redoran residing in Bal Isra.
Hibaddar Ilath-Pal is a Dunmer barbarian who resides in the Molag Amur region of Vvardenfell.
Hinammu Shishara is a Dunmer residing in Morrowind. He is a miner and lives in the town of Gnisis.

Hinummu Siddurnanit is a Dunmer Mabrigash who resides in Morrowind. She resides at a bonfire camp on a little hill northeast and next to Berandas. She, along with her partners, Elitlaya Assonirishpal and Hansi Saharnatturapli will attack the Nerevarine on sight, unless a charm spell is cast, followed by raising their dispositions.

King Hidellith Aldmeri was an Altmeri King of Alinor during the Second Era. He was the father of Ayrenn and Naemon, whom he conceived with his wife, Kinlady Tuinden. Hidellith passed away in 2E 580, and was succeeded by his eldest child, Ayrenn.

High King Emeric was the Breton High King of High Rock, leader of the Daggerfall Covenant and the Earl of Cumberland during the Second Era. He led High Rock, Hammerfell, Orsinium and the Daggerfall Covenant against the other alliances in the Three Banners War to gain control of the Ruby Throne. He resides in Wayrest Castle in Wayrest, Stormhaven. His wife is Queen Maraya, daughter of King Fahara'jad. He mentions that he also has respect for both of the other alliances, the Ebonheart Pact and the Aldmeri Dominion.
Herkja is a member of the Thirsk Mead Hall found on Solstheim. She can be found enthralled at the Temple of Miraak alongside Sirkjorg, another member of Thirsk Mead Hall.
The High Justiciar is a Justiciar responsible for affirming which heir of the royal family of Alinor has right to assume the throne.
Hession is an Altmer publican who lives in Godsreach. She is the proprietor of The Winged Guar, and she asks the Nerevarine to replace her bouncer, who is ill.
Hiranar is an Altmer cultural researcher for the Thalmor who resides in Reaper's March in Valenwood.
Hidabah is a Redguard residing in Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai. She is found waiting outside Headman Bhosek's Palace and apparently she has been waiting for some time.

High Kinlady Estre is an Altmer High Kinlady and member of the royal family of Alinor, as well as the Canonreeve of Skywatch. She is married to Prince Naemon and sister-in-law to Queen Ayrenn. It wasn't a secret that Estre was bitter about losing the throne when Ayrenn returned, so Ayrenn, looking to smooth their relationship, elevated Estre to a high position in the Thalmor and made it a point to hold her final coronation ceremony in the city of Skywatch. She is also the hidden main antagonist in the Auridon region.
High Overseer Kvotai is a powerful Dremora bounded by the Oathbound Clan found within the Obsidian Scar.

High Kinlord Rilis XIII is the Altmer ruler of Firsthold, and the son of Rilis XII. He is also the leader of the First Auridon Marines and is currently accompanying Queen Ayrenn during her visit to Vulkhel Guard.
Heranwen is an Altmer carpenter residing in the city of Vulkhel Guard in Auridon.
Heryemo is an Altmer beggar residing in Elden Root in the region Grahtwood. He can be found in the Altmer Embassy.
Herane is a Breton residing in Crosswych, Glenumbra. He can be found in one of the open buildings in the town.
Heron Mathis is a Breton residing in Alcaire Castle in the region of Stormhaven. He is located just inside the southern gates.
Hilaria Aubertin is a Breton weaponsmith, and resides in Alcaire Castle, in the region of Stormhaven. She owns and operates a stall, The Adventurer's Edge, in the Castle's local marketplace.
Hides-His-Foot is an Argonian Slave residing on the Dren Plantation. He belongs to the plantation's owner Orvas Dren and can be freed during the quest "Free Hides-His-Foot."
Hilan is a Dunmer member of the Fighters Guild. He is the hall steward of their branch in Davon's Watch.
High Kinlord Rilis IV is an Altmer ghost of the Rilis family found in the catacombs beneath Castle Rilis.
Heritance Cutthroat is a character in . They are a member of the Veiled Heritance, working to replace Queen Ayrenn as ruler of the Altmeri people.
Heritance Soldier is a member of the Veiled Heritance, a faction dedicated to replacing Queen Ayrenn as ruler over the Altmeri people.
High Priest Zuladr is a Redguard residing in Satakalaam, in the Alik'r Desert region.
Herric Celiane is a Breton banker. He works out of the Bank of Evermore.
Hinaamo is an Altmer residing in the city of Mistral, in Khenarthi's Roost.
Hiraira is a Redguard residing in the city of Camlorn, Glenumbra.
Hides-in-Mud is an Argonian residing outside the Hlan House in Quarantine Serk.
Hiis-Ja is an Argonian magus and member of the Mages Guild working at Egg-Siblings' Magical Goods on the island of Eyevea.
Herdmaster Agata Gregorie is a Breton supervising the horses found in the Silverhoof Vale.
Hesolmo is an Altmer patron of The Parchment & Horn in Marbruk.
Hetsha is a Maormer member of the Sea Vipers found along with Jahlasri and Neiral at the Maormer Camp in Greenshade.
Hiath the Battlemaster is a Dunmer follower of Boethiah and the current grand champion of the Dragonstar Arena. He is the author of Dragonstar Arena Guest Book.
Hides-Aplenty is an Argonian leatherworker in who sells her wares alongside Has-No-Loom and Weaves-One-Basket at the collective stall "Baskets of Steel" in the Dhalmora Hall of Merchants, Bal Foyen.
High Kinlord Rilis I is an Altmer ghost of the Rilis family found in the catacombs beneath Castle Rilis.
High Kinlord Rilis II is an Altmer ghost of the Rilis family found in the catacombs beneath Castle Rilis.
High Kinlord Rilis III is an Altmer ghost of the Rilis family found in the catacombs beneath Castle Rilis.
High Kinlord Rilis IX is an Altmer ghost of the Rilis family found in the catacombs beneath Castle Rilis.
High Kinlord Rilis V is an Altmer ghost of the Rilis family found in the catacombs beneath Castle Rilis.
High Kinlord Rilis VI is an Altmer ghost of the Rilis family found in the catacombs beneath Castle Rilis.
High Kinlord Rilis VIII is an Altmer ghost of the Rilis family found in the catacombs beneath Castle Rilis.
High Kinlord Rilis XI is an Altmer ghost of the Rilis family found in the catacombs beneath Castle Rilis.
High Ordinator Danys is a Dunmer member of the Ordinators. Him and his team were sent to Gil-Var-Delle by Almalexia herself to restore and rid it of Molag Bal's influence.
